meta.description: Query the CZ CELLxGENE Census programmatically for versioned public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data. Use when you need population-scale cell metadata, gene expression slices, Census summary counts, source H5AD URIs/downloads, embeddings, spatial Census data, or reference atlas comparisons across organisms, tissues, diseases, assays, and cell types.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabrication; accurately describes Census data (217M+ cells, 1,845 datasets in 2025-11-08 LTS) with proper versioning

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for population-scale single-cell queries; clear boundary directing to scanpy/anndata/scvi-tools for local data analysis

methodological_ground.detail: Based on standardized CZ CELLxGENE Discover data with reproducibility via census_version pinning

code_usability.detail: Code examples executable with proper imports and version pinning guidance

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive coverage of Census workflows: opening, exploring, querying, large-scale processing, ML integration, spatial data, Scanpy integration, multi-dataset analysis

reliability.note: Excellent reliability guidance: is_primary_data filtering to avoid duplicates, query size estimation before loading, version pinning for reproducibility

performance_context.note: Well-organized with clear sections and reference files; performance guidance (out-of-core for >100k cells); could benefit from query timing estimates

agent_usability.note: Excellent 'When to Use' with 7 specific scenarios; clear scope boundary to scanpy/anndata/scvi-tools for local data; comprehensive best practices section

human_usability.note: Clear installation with version pinning (1.17.x), spatial extra documented, deprecated ML loader warning, no authentication required noted

security.note: Good practices: public data requires no credentials; minor: data download size limits not explicitly discussed for preventing resource exhaustion

maintainability.note: Excellent structure with version 1.2, license (MIT), Census version tracking (2025-11-08 LTS), deprecation warnings for experimental ML loaders

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with allowed-tools and integration patterns; clear data flow; minor: output format specifications for large queries could be more explicit

recommendations.problem: get_presence_matrix usage shown but output format not explained

recommendations.fix: Add note: 'Presence matrix returns DataFrame with datasets as rows, genes as columns, boolean values indicating measurement. Filter datasets where all queried genes are True before querying expression.'
